text: A short exact sequence of chain complexes 0 → A• → B• → C• → 0 induces a long exact sequence in homology.
explanation: ⋯ → Hₙ(A) → Hₙ(B) → Hₙ(C) →∂→ Hₙ₋₁(A) → ⋯, with the connecting map ∂ built by the snake lemma. This long exact sequence is the central computational engine of homological algebra and algebraic topology.
